title: Having astra make games my nephews can play
author: EdgarDruin
selftext:
Been traveling and visiting family.  My nephews know I code and use AI.  I'd mentioned I've used it to make simple games.  They asked if we could make one.  We settled on a simple scrap hauler game with magnets and upgrades.

  
[https://playgama.ai/play/c5bqlbvbpg](https://playgama.ai/play/c5bqlbvbpg)

  
I keep working more complex games, but tossing out small stuff like this helps me keep iterating with AI, finding things that work, where I need to be in the loop or not, how to get useful prompts for graphics or UI or whatever.

  
It's an amusing change from the day job!
